title: Check 1.1: Interpreting Expressions

questions.q: In the expression 6x² − 4x + 9, the coefficient of x is:
A gym charges C = 25m + 60, where m is the number of months. What does 60 represent?

explains: The coefficient of x is the number multiplied by x, which is −4.
The constant is the amount paid no matter how many months.
Like terms have exactly the same variable part.

title: Check 2.3: Linear Inequalities

questions.q: A student has $60 and each book costs $8. What is the most books she can buy?

explains: Dividing by a negative flips the sign: x ≥ −4.
Subtract 1 from each part, then divide each by 2.
8b ≤ 60 gives b ≤ 7.5, and she cannot buy half a book.

title: Check 3.1: Functions and Function Notation

questions.q: Which set of ordered pairs is a function?
If g(x) = x² + 1, what is g(−3)?

explains: Each input appears only once, so it is a function.
The domain is the set of inputs.

title: Check 3.2: Slope and Rate of Change

questions.q: Find the slope of the line through (2, 3) and (6, 11).
Find the slope of the line through (1, 5) and (4, −1).
What is the slope of a horizontal line?
The temperature rises from 50°F to 74°F in 6 hours. What is the average rate of change?

explains: A horizontal line has no rise, so its slope is 0.

title: Check 3.3: Writing Linear Equations

questions.q: Write the equation of the line with slope 3 and y intercept −2.
Which equation is the line through (0, 1) and (2, 5)?
A line is parallel to y = 4x − 3 and passes through (0, 7). Its equation is:
What is the slope of a line perpendicular to y = 2x + 5?

explains: The slope is 4/2 = 2 and the y intercept is 1.
Parallel lines share a slope of 4.
